_about: Speech-to-text profiles for another P25 system's talkgroups (radio-intel PR 3; sizeup/stt_vocab.py profile()). A source key (sizeup/sourcekeys.py: p25:<system>:<tg>) names its profile, else its service does. prompt: whisper's text, police phrasing only, never a talker's or a person's name; the headquarters' callsigns (data/pd_units.json) and the busiest streets of the towns (the gazetteer, at runtime) are added to it. vocabulary: the Amazon Transcribe custom vocabulary those sources use (stt_vocab.police_phrases(), kept apart from the fire one).

police.prompt: Police dispatch. 10-4, 10-20. Respond to, en route, on scene, in the area, be advised, all units, copy, negative, disregard.
